about.text: Semi-skimmed milk heated to 135–150 °C for a few seconds and packed sterile, so that it keeps for months unopened without a fridge. Sold in Germany as fettarme H-Milch.

picture.file: 22-07-2017 Carton of UHT Milk of Matinal brand.JPG
picture.author: Kolforn

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Semi-skimmed milk, with its fat set to 1.5 %, goes through the same ultra-high heat as whole UHT milk and is filled into sterile cartons, so it keeps for months without cooling.

steps.note: About 75 °C in an indirect plant, about 80 °C in a direct one.
In indirect plants before UHT, or aseptically after.
Continuous flow; an indirect plant holds about 4 s at about 138 °C, a direct plant steam-injects to 140–150 °C and flash-cools in vacuum.
